status: Intake summary of source-authored claims only. No claim is accepted by this intake. No supplied program was executed.

claims.claimed_result: Restricted N=8 eight-resolvent exclusion via five phase quadrics and a 20-by-20 cubic Macaulay certificate. Separately, N+1 holonomy parameters and a nonzero four-by-four Jacobian minor establish local cross-ratio dominance for fixed audited graph orderings at N=8,16,32.
claims.stated_limit: N>=16 exclusion audits are sampled. Local dominance does not construct the actual Fourier phase target. No general-input sub-NlogN DFT or faster multiplication bound.

claims.claimed_result: Noninvertible symplectic B blocks force kernel zeros. Invertible B blocks give monomial equivalence to additive Fourier on (Z/p^s Z)^n. Cross-ratio exponent structure obstructs replacing the equal-size cyclic transform by the dense higher-dimensional ring-Weil stage.
claims.stated_limit: Closes a particular cyclic embedding route. No faster exact cyclic FFT is constructed.

claims.claimed_result: Three-column symmetric-square certificate with free diagonal gauges and a positive fixed-stage spectral-error gap. N=3,4 examples claim separation from a singular old commutator using modular data and simple-root Hensel lifting.
claims.stated_limit: Numerical diagnostics are not interval-certified. No arbitrary-input O(N) FFT or peer-reviewed novelty claim.

claims.claimed_result: Consecutive-support zero bound implies s+t>=N+1 in a diagonal-gauged Fourier factorization F=D_L P Q^{-1}D_R. Boundary interpolation is unique up to column scalars, with field-dependent denominator invertibility.
claims.stated_limit: Classical polynomial-zero/Fourier-uncertainty ingredients. Degree rigidity is not an arithmetic-time lower bound; source explicitly declines historical priority.

claims.claimed_result: Continuous paired-weight and gauge-curvature energy obstructions for bounded-depth bounded-norm Green networks, plus O(E) arithmetic weight certificates and a rank-k Frobenius floor.
claims.stated_limit: Restricted necessary conditions, not faster Fourier algorithms or universal lower bounds. The eighth-root identity and half-grid spectrum were already Phase 15 results.

claims.claimed_result: Concrete all-input DFT on N=60*2^t with nested Winograd diagonal kernels. Source operation count C28(N)=90H log2(H)+498H+15, H=N/60, improves the Phase 27 comparator by 46H warm operations and 46H-29 cold operations.
claims.stated_limit: Established Winograd/Good–Thomas ingredients; work remains Theta(N log N). No optimality, floating-point benchmark, or bit-complexity theorem.

claims.claimed_result: One origin-regular scalar straight-line program whose degree-two jets agree with (1/2)x^T F_N x on every two-coordinate plane has Hessian F_N. A Hessian-vector compiler computes arbitrary dense-input F_Nv in O(s+N) arithmetic and storage.
claims.stated_limit: A synthesis equivalence, not a fast source construction. Classical differentiation ingredients. Formal jets, not only finite-field pointwise equalities, are required. A sub-NlogN source remains missing.
